question: Deliver ONE concrete protection circuit, with named parts and explicit fault cases, that addresses the internal capacitor-discharge loop and the line-fed loop.
focus: Deliver ONE concrete protection circuit for the boost-switch-short and surge cases, with named parts and explicit fault cases. Not a list of options. 1) NAME THE PARTS: every device by manufacturer and order code, with the source establishing its rating for THIS application (DC rating, pulsed current, breaking capacity, energy handling). 2) EXPLICIT FAULT CASES, separated because device state changes the answer: (a) U10 shorted, U9 HEALTHY - can detection plus turn-off interrupt, and what detection/latency budget is assumed; (b) U10 shorted, U9 FAILED SHORT - what interrupts, and if nothing does, say so; (c) line-fed switch short with the bridge following; (d) the line-surge case; (e) every fault the arrangement CANNOT interrupt. 3) SIZE FROM THE PULSE, NOT THE AVERAGE: the ~4.5 A average bus current is not a sizing basis. State the pulse waveform and prospective current used, or leave the element unsized and name what would size it. 4) COORDINATED CLEARING: show the named element clears inside the surviving devices' ratings, or state that coordination is NOT demonstrated. 5) MOV SELECTION as part of the arrangement: name the MOV and the clamp characteristic REQUIRED at the operating surge current. Resolve the clamp from the manufacturer V-I - the 50 A point is an UPPER bound at that current only and does not bound any other current. The surge contract is PROVISIONAL (assumed IEC 61000-4-5 1/2 kV, not adopted); mark what is assumed and what would settle it. A MOV line-surge clamp does not resolve the internal discharge fault. 6) EVIDENCE LEDGER (required): write claims.json beside your report and run `zapote-claims claims.json`; it must pass, with the output retained. Each claim carries value_kind, bound_kind, source_condition, part, fault_state, assertion strength, evidence as {path, sha256} resolving to retained bytes, and a completion status with the evidence supporting it. Completion statuses advance one rung at a time from none. Any current/energy assignment must also pass `python3 zapote/tools/check_fault_loop.py --netlist <netlist> --loop-nets PFC_BUS_PLUS_390V,PFC_BUS_MINUS,a1 --assignments <assignments.json>`, output retained. 7) State which quantities remain null and what would resolve them.
stop_rule: Do not present a proposal as a resolved design; do not size an element from an average current; do not collapse healthy and failed-short device states; do not reverse a bound direction or drop a source condition or part; do not claim coordination without showing it; do not present the surge contract as adopted. 'No arrangement interrupts case (b) with available parts' is a valid and important result.
